capabilities: chat with AI models in a sidebar with streaming responses
include active note context and file mentions in prompts
sign in via Claude Max OAuth, Anthropic API key, or ChatGPT Plus/Codex
review and apply agent-generated file edits through a multi-file diff UI
extras: Desktop-only. Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. Disclosures state that prompts, note context, and responses are sent to Anthropic or OpenAI, and that API keys, OAuth tokens, and chat session IDs are stored in vault plugin data. Agent edits can modify vault files, so the README advises reviewing generated diffs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, so users must leave the app or wire up separate tools to chat with models over their notes.

relations.evidence: Claude Max OAuth support, an Anthropic API key fallback

summary: Desktop-only plugin that adds an AI chat sidebar using Claude Max OAuth, an Anthropic API key, or ChatGPT Plus/Codex, with note context and diff review.
